title: France vs Spain World Cup semi-final: Mbappe and Yamal predictions
facts: France and Spain were scheduled to play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup semifinals at Dallas Stadium in Arlington, Texas. [cite: 255]
France topped Group I in the 2026 World Cup with a perfect record of nine points. [cite: 255]
France recorded victories against Norway, Senegal, and Iraq during the 2026 World Cup group stage. [cite: 255]
France defeated Morocco 2-0 in the quarterfinals to reach the 2026 World Cup semifinals. [cite: 255]
Spain topped Group H in the 2026 World Cup with seven points. [cite: 255]
Spain secured a 2-1 victory over Belgium in the quarterfinals of the 2026 World Cup. [cite: 255]
Kylian Mbappe led the 2026 World Cup Golden Boot race with eight goals in five games ahead of the semifinal. [cite: 255]
France's Ousmane Dembele scored five goals leading up to the 2026 World Cup semifinal match. [cite: 255]
Michael Olise recorded five assists for France prior to the 2026 World Cup semifinal. [cite: 255]
Kylian Mbappe scored 20 goals in 20 appearances across three separate World Cup tournaments. [cite: 255]
The France national team reached four of the last seven World Cup finals prior to 2026. [cite: 255]
Luis de la Fuente served as the head coach of the Spain national football team during the 2026 World Cup. [cite: 255]
Spain previously defeated France in the semifinals of the Euro 2024 tournament. [cite: 255]
Spain and France played each other 38 times prior to their 2026 World Cup semifinal matchup. [cite: 255]
Spain defeated France 5-4 in the UEFA Nations League semifinals in 2025. [cite: 255]
